planets.name: TOI-2076 d
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-2076 with a 35.1-day year, found in 2021.

text.card: TOI-2076 d was found in 2021 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 4 planets known around TOI-2076. Its orbit and size follow Wang et al. 2026's fit, the archive's default.
